decision.description: The resolution outcome: 'resolve' when a single tree satisfies BOTH specs' intent + acceptance criteria; 'irreconcilable' when no single edit can satisfy both and one spec must be re-planned with the other's change as context.

reasoning.description: Why this resolution preserves both intents (when 'resolve'), or why the two intents cannot both be satisfied by one edit (when 'irreconcilable'). Cite each conflicting spec's acceptance criteria.

newContext.description: The OTHER spec's change, summarized as new planning context so the re-planned spec satisfies its intent ON TOP of the other's change — keeping both intents alive.

which.description: Which spec re-plans: 'merging' (the spec whose PR is being merged) or 'base' (the spec already merged on the base branch).

replanSpec.description: When decision='irreconcilable': which spec to re-plan ('merging' = the spec whose PR is merging; 'base' = the spec already on the base branch) plus the new planning context to carry. Null when decision='resolve'.

resolvedFiles.description: When decision='resolve': the full resolved content for EVERY conflicted file. Empty/omitted when decision='irreconcilable'.

content.description: The FULL resolved UTF-8 content of the file with conflict markers removed, preserving BOTH specs' intent. This is the whole file, not a patch or a single hunk.

path.description: The conflicted file path (repo-relative), exactly as presented in the conflict hunks.
